description: Twelve centred circular medallions, each isolated on a near-black ground with a generous empty margin — the frame is used only as a void around a single centred emblem, never composed into. The palette is very tight: near-black field, one sage/teal green, one cream/bone off-white, plus a darker teal for shadowed detail; there is essentially no third hue anywhere in the twelve. The shared vocabulary is rotational (roughly 6- to 8-fold): an outer annulus or scalloped rim, an inner disc, a pinwheel of curved comma/blade shapes radiating from a small starburst core, and small petal, wedge or tile elements studding the perimeter. What differs between seeds is almost entirely COVERAGE and which of those layers are present: 9011, 10622 and 10980 are dense layered wreaths with rim, core and outer petals; 10264 and 10085 are single-disc rosettes; 10443 is a hollow ring of scattered square tiles; 9906 is a bare dashed cream circle with nothing inside; 9727 is a sparse ghost-ring of faint pale crescents; 9369 and 10801 are flat unmodulated green blobs with only edge incident; and 9190 is completely EMPTY — a blank dark panel in every sheet and every condition. Across the three conditions the changes are small and internal: on 9011 the rim's mottling flattens and the outer petals grow and rotate; on 9548 the blade set visibly widens and flips from near-black to sage; on 9369 only the perimeter jaggedness softens; on 9190 nothing changes because nothing is drawn.
seenAt120: At browse size roughly half the set survives as itself. The dense wreaths (9011, 10622, 10980, 10264) and the tile-ring (10443) and dashed ring (9906) still read as distinct objects because their silhouette carries a hole, a rim or a broken edge. The rest collapse: 9369 and 10801 are indistinguishable green dots, 10085 is a green dot with a pale smudge, 9548 is a green dot with a faint dark swirl, 9727 nearly disappears into the ground, and 9190 is an empty tile. Interior blade detail is gone in every case; only the silhouette and the light/dark ring banding survive. The market-condition differences are not visible at all at 120px — a stress and a neutral tile of the same seed would be indistinguishable.
